purpose: Define a positive-evidence, point-in-time AI-Core eligibility layer independent of market performance.

upstream.mother_pool: Official U-layer / prospective PIT universe for the signal date.

candidate_hint_only_not_authority: official filing search metadata before underlying filing text is verified

temporal_rule.historical: Evidence disclosure_date must be strictly before signal_date unless an exact pre-signal availability timestamp is frozen.
temporal_rule.prospective: A newly observed evidence item may only change eligibility from the first trading date after its authoritative repository observation time; no backfill.
temporal_rule.revision: A later official revision supersedes the earlier document only from the revision's legal availability time forward.

classification_states.ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE: Official filing proves that the issuer or consolidated subsidiary offers a product/service whose substantive function is AI/ML/model/AI-compute and also proves commercial operation.
classification_states.EXCLUDED_AI_ADOPTER_ONLY: Evidence only shows internal use/procurement of AI to improve the issuer's own operations; no external AI business is established.
classification_states.EXCLUDED_AI_RND_ONLY: Evidence only shows research, planning, exploration, testing or future intention; commercialization is not established.
classification_states.NOT_ESTABLISHED: No qualifying positive evidence has been verified. This is not a definitive non-AI claim.
classification_states.BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS: Evidence is contradictory, identity/temporal provenance is unresolved, or the text cannot establish the required conjunction.

eligibility_conjunction.COMPANY_BUSINESS_SUBJECT: The statement concerns the issuer or a consolidated operating subsidiary, not an industry trend, investee, customer or unrelated third party.
DIRECT_AI_PRODUCT_OR_SERVICE: machine-vision/robot/autonomy product only when AI/ML is explicitly part of the product function
COMMERCIAL_OPERATION: customer/order/contract evidence tied to the AI product/service

explicit_non_qualifiers: generic statements that AI is an industry trend
internal AI office/management/manufacturing efficiency use only
planned/future AI R&D without commercial evidence
generic semiconductor/electronics/data-center products merely benefiting from AI demand
generic robot/automation/smart-product wording without explicit AI/ML functionality
holding an equity investment in an AI company without the issuer itself operating the qualifying business
